{{Quote|Looks like we've joined the Rebellion after all. Now, how do we get at those butchers down there?|[[Godking]] [[Trisstan]]|<ref name="TotG" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were discussing an alliance with the leader of the [[Anointed People]] of Abonshee, [[Godking]] [[Trisstan]], a damaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] transporting the [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] landed near the [[Godking's castle]] for repairs. The Godking wished to discuss with the Imperials but the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] escorting the Governor-General got afraid by the mob gathering near the shuttle and opened fire on civilians. Trisstan ''de facto'' joined the Rebellion and sent his warriors fight the Imperial troops along with Alliance operatives. The Rebels eventually boarded the shuttle and captured the Governor-General.<ref name="TotG" />
